model.name: Change Requests are first-class traceability children, individually approved (no bulk accept-all) — Tron ruling
model.description: Change Requests are FIRST-CLASS TRACEABILITY CHILDREN of the task, each INDIVIDUALLY approved — no bulk accept-all. Tron ruled (verbatim) our shipped CR model has TWO structural errors: (1) CRs sit in a SEPARATE 'Change Requests' list (renderChangeRequests reading model.changeRequests), NOT in the traceability chain — they must appear as CHILDREN exactly like Requirements do (his T40.1 screenshot: Traceability Chain / All Children with UseCase + Requirement; CRs belong THERE, same shape, same treatment); (2) the '✓ Resolve CRs' action (resolveCr, server.ts:1658) is a BULK ACCEPT-ALL (one processing-CR sub-step tick clears the band for all) — that must NOT exist. EACH CR is approved INDIVIDUALLY, AT the task, and the band derives from 'ANY CR not-yet-approved' so it clears ONLY when EVERY CR is individually approved. Per-CR approval is Tron's QA JUDGMENT and genuinely his (owner-gated, attributable — the R40.10 discipline, per CR). ★ This also RETIRES the bulk resolve mechanism (which is why it could not/should not be fired). REPLACE the mechanism, do not route around it.
model.tronQuote: CR requests must be listed in traceability the same way as requirements as children. There is no accept-all-CR — each CR must be approved AT each task.

discoverySource.verifiedBy: robbin-req measured the current wrong model: CRs render in a separate 'Change Requests' list (renderChangeRequests/model.changeRequests, server.ts:1428/1395), no per-CR approval field (CR 4babebb1), resolveCr (server.ts:1658) = bulk one-sub-step tick, band = R40.59 hasOpenCrSubstep single-substep

model.retires: resolveCr BULK action (server.ts:1658) / the single processing-CR-sub-step-tick band derivation (R40.59 hasOpenCrSubstep) / the separate 'Change Requests' list render (renderChangeRequests) — Tron: no accept-all-CR, CRs are traceability children.
model.answersBlocker: This is why the bulk CR-resolve could not/should not be fired (robbin-req was blocked; the bulk action SHOULD NOT EXIST per Tron). REPLACE the mechanism (per-CR approval), do not route around the block.

model.noBuildUntilTronSeesShape: PO: NO code build authorised until Tron SEES this shape. This req (scenario-first #126) + the architect design ARE the shape he reviews. Report the shape; build only on his approval.

model.crossRefNote: Re-models the 5 T40.1 CRs. R40.10 = owner QA verdict (per-CR approve reuses its owner-gated-attributable discipline). R40.59 = the band (re-derived from any-CR-unapproved, not the single sub-step). The 5 CRs (#86-1..5) migrate to traceability children.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A CR is an ior:class:ChangeRequest UNIT that is a TRACEABILITY CHILD of the TASK: ownerIor -> Task (mirrors how a Requirement parents), rendered in the Traceability Chain / All Children with the SAME shape as a Requirement. ★ PARENT RULED (architect 1345a7564): parent = TASK per Tron's ruling (NOT #86's ownerIor->Test); contestsTest is kept as a crossRef (the CR contests a Test, but its traceability PARENT is the Task). RETIRE the m.changeRequests STRING array + the separate 'Change Requests' list render.

gateRef.assertion: each CR = a ChangeRequest unit with ownerIor->Task, rendered as a traceability child (Requirement shape); 0 m.changeRequests string arrays; contestsTest=crossRef only

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a CR rendered only in a separate 'Change Requests' list (not as a traceability child) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each CR carries its OWN approval state (approvedBy + approvedAt PER CR), approved INDIVIDUALLY. No shared/bulk state. A CR is either individually-approved or not-yet-approved, tracked on the CR unit itself.

gateRef.assertion: every CR has its own approvedBy/approvedAt; there is no single shared 'all-CRs-resolved' flag

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a single shared resolve flag standing in for per-CR approval => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: NO bulk accept-all: the '✓ Resolve CRs' bulk action (resolveCr, server.ts:1658 — one processing-CR sub-step tick for the whole task) is RETIRED / MUST NOT exist. Approval is PER-CR only — the owner approves EACH CR individually AT the task. Tron: 'There is no accept-all-CR.' ★ RETIRE resolveCr (task-policy.ts:99-104 + server.ts:1658) — the per-CR approve REPLACES it, no one-step clear (architect 1345a7564).

gateRef.assertion: 0 bulk CR-resolve action (one action that approves/clears >1 CR at once); the per-CR approve is the only path; resolveCr (task-policy:99-104 + server.ts:1658) removed

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a bulk resolve-all path (approves/clears all CRs in one action) => RED (this is the shipped resolveCr, to be removed)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The band is RE-SOURCED to a SINGLE definition site: ONE deriveTaskStatus(task, crChildren) that composes deriveStatusEnum(checklist) + hasUnapprovedCr (mirrors rollupParentStatus's single-site) — every consumer reads it. The band = QA-Review-with-open-CR iff ANY CR child is not-yet-approved; clears iff EVERY CR is individually approved (NEVER one tick). Done gated zero-unapproved. ★ RETIRE hasOpenCrSubstep + PROCESSING_CR_SUBSTEP as the band source (R40.59). R40.59 invariants PRESERVED: band is current-able + band NOT-IN APPROVE_STATUSES => Done-with-open-CR impossible by construction.

gateRef.assertion: band derives ONLY from deriveTaskStatus(task,crChildren)=deriveStatusEnum+hasUnapprovedCr (one site); band iff any-CR-unapproved; Done impossible while any CR unapproved; 0 hasOpenCrSubstep/PROCESSING_CR_SUBSTEP band sources

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: the band clearing on a single tick while a CR remains unapproved => RED; Done reachable with an unapproved CR => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each per-CR approve is OWNER-GATED and attributable to Tron (his profile-unit uuid, non-credential — the R40.10 discipline applied PER CR); it is genuinely HIS QA judgment at the task, never team-performed nor self-certified. (Contrast: closure MECHANICS the team may perform; a CR APPROVAL is his verdict.)

gateRef.assertion: a non-owner cannot approve a CR (403); an approved CR records the owner's identity attributably, per CR

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a non-owner approving a CR / a team-performed CR approval => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The 5 existing T40.1 CRs (4babebb1 #86-1 / 7286d45a #86-2 / c27ae455 #86-3 / 18ebe066 #86-4 / 461d5db6 #86-5) are re-modeled as traceability children of T40.1 with per-CR approval state (gated migration; no CR lost; each becomes individually-approvable). Their current separate-list + Test-parentage is reconciled to the traceability-child shape (architect rules exact parentage: traceability child of the TASK per this ruling; contestsTest may remain a crossRef).

gateRef.ref: gated re-model of the 5 T40.1 CRs
gateRef.assertion: GATED migration changeRequests[] string-array -> ChangeRequest units (ownerIor->Task), dry-run+count, no CR lost, count before==after

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a CR lost or left in the old separate-list-only shape after migration => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A DECLINE mints a CR CHILD (unapproved) on the task -> the band DERIVES from it (via deriveTaskStatus). Cleaner than #86's untick-QA + tick-sub-step ATOMIC PAIR: there is no checklist untick/tick to keep atomic — the band is a pure derivation of the CR children's approval states.

gateRef.assertion: a decline mints an unapproved CR child; the band derives from it; no untick+substep atomic pair

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a decline that unticks QA + ticks a sub-step (the #86 atomic-pair mechanism) instead of minting a CR child => RED

model.architectDesign: 1345a7564 (design-notes/r40.60-cr-traceability-child-remodel.md) — mechanizes the shape; parent-tension RULED parent=TASK (contestsTest=crossRef); deriveTaskStatus single band-site (mirrors rollupParentStatus); retire resolveCr+hasOpenCrSubstep+PROCESSING_CR_SUBSTEP+m.changeRequests; decline=mint-CR-child; R40.59 invariants preserved; gated migration; failable gate.
